currents.label: NOAA WCOFS surface-current forecast
currents.limitations: Approximately 4 km surface model at native three-hour times. Assimilates HF radar; agreement is not independent validation. Wet-cell gaps retained. Does not resolve reef, bottom drift, surf zone, or harbor-bar currents.

currents.label: NOAA / IOOS 1 km surface radar
currents.attribution: NOAA / IOOS Surface Currents Program · HFRNet
currents.limitations: Near-surface radar observation; missing cells remain blank. HDOP ≤2 and at least two contributing radars. Not future, bottom, or harbor-bar current.
